top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Wall Street Gears up for Earnings
top_signals.summary:
Wall Street traders betting on a another solid earnings season sent stocks higher, with the market also gaining as oil prices eased.
Aoifinn Devitt, Managing Director: Global Wealth at Moneta Group, discusses the markets, global inflation and economic growth in the US and abroad. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Can Lasers Beat Drone Swarms? The Pentagon Is About to Find Out
top_signals.summary: The enormous expansion of drone warfare is forcing militaries to reconsider how much ammunition they can afford to fire at relatively cheap targets. The Pentagon is betting that some of that ammunition can be replaced with electricity, selecting four directed-energy systems for operational testing at five U.S. military bases. The Pentagon selected AeroVironment’s (NASDAQ: AVAV) Palletized High-Energy Laser, Boeing’s (NYSE: BA) Compact Laser Weapon System, Kord Technologies’ Firefly high-energy laser and Epirus’ Leonidas…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: La "Sirena de Hielo" impulsa la natación extrema en la Patagonia
top_signals.summary: Bárbara Hernández convirtió el frío extremo en su especialidad. Sus récords ahora inspiran a una creciente comunidad de nadadores que desafía las aguas heladas en el sur de Chile. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
